memory_candidates: The general same-depth composition theorem (depth-(K+1) 1-var + orders => depth-(K+1) r-var on non-constant envs) is NOT provable by induction on K alone. The quantifier transfer at the inductive step requires a SINGLE witness y' matching orders with ALL r environment elements simultaneously. nf_extend_fwd from different base elements gives different witnesses with incompatible positions. This is the same phenomenon as the counterexample in NfComposition.lean:20-36.

constenv_same_depth_2var is provable WITHOUT induction on K. The proof is uniform: atoms from pred_agree_cross + irrefl order, quantifiers from exist_transfer_nvar_constenv (which uses cross_extend_fwd/bwd + constenv_2var_determines). Key: Fin.cons y (Fin.cons t (fun _ => t)) = Fin.cons y (fun _ => t) on Fin 3, reducing 3-var existentials to constant-parent form.
Fin.cases t (fun _ => t) i = t for all i : Fin (n+1). Proved by Fin.cases rfl (fun _ => rfl) i. Essential for atom_eval rewriting on constant envs where Fin.cons introduces Fin.cases.
